name: Fast Path Check
description: Advises TPM at session start when the workspace lives on a slow /mnt/c/... path so the user can move to a WSL-native location for faster I/O.

fastpathDirectory.label: Fast Path Directory
fastpathDirectory.description: Optional override for the WSL-native target directory the session launcher cd's into when this module is enabled. Leave blank to let the launcher compute it from the current workspace path (e.g. /mnt/c/Users/<user>/foo → ~/projects/foo).
